title: US, Japan and South Korea Launch Economic-Security Talks Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit
detail: The United States, Japan, and South Korea launched formal economic-security talks in New York ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, coordinating positions on technology export controls and supply chain resilience.

title: South Korea Steps In to Plug Europe's Jet Fuel Deficit
detail: South Korea is stepping in to supply jet fuel to Europe amid a regional deficit, likely tied to disrupted Gulf shipping routes affecting global energy distribution networks.
